presentation.label: Euclidean Sequencing
presentation.summary: Generate rhythms from two pulse generators on each audio or MIDI track. Rotate either generator, rotate the whole result and combine them with OR, XOR, AND or SUB.
presentation.overview: Generate rhythms from two pulse generators on each audio or MIDI track. Rotate either generator, rotate the whole result and combine them with OR, XOR, AND or SUB.
highlights: Track length; editable in PER TRACK scale mode, up to 64 steps.
Turn to enable/disable; press to toggle immediately.
usage: Create a few source trigs on an audio track with a loaded sample. Hold FUNC + AMP to open Euclidean.
Set PL1 to 5, PL2 to 0 and enable EUC with D. With a 16-step track this distributes five hits across the loop.
Press PLAY. Turn RO1 to move those hits, then add PL2 pulses and try the OP combinations.

Turn D off to restore the ordinary sequence. Press NO, or a page key such as TRIG or FLTR, to leave. Use FUNC while turning D off only when you want to replace the ordinary trigs with the generated result.

access.location: Hold FUNC + AMP; NO or a page key closes the page
steps: Create a few source trigs on an audio track with a loaded sample. Hold FUNC + AMP to open Euclidean.

controls.name: C — LEN
controls.doc: Track length; editable in PER TRACK scale mode, up to 64 steps.

controls.name: D — EUC
controls.doc: Turn to enable/disable; press to toggle immediately.

controls.name: H — OP
controls.doc: Choose OR, XOR, AND or SUB.

controls.name: FUNC + turn D off
controls.doc: Convert the generated sequence into ordinary trigs.

controls.name: TRK + trig / NO
controls.doc: Select an audio or MIDI track / close the page.

controls.name: TRIG / SRC / FLTR / AMP / LFO
controls.doc: Close Euclidean and open that page. FUNC + TRIG, FLTR, AMP or LFO opens Quantize, Delay, Reverb or Compressor.

limitations: Generated hits use successive source steps and their locks.
Four panel counts move A–H by one value in 1.1.3; D’s press toggle remains immediate.
In common scale mode, change length through the normal scale menu.
Conversion replaces ordinary trigs; ordinary EUC-off is nondestructive.
Stock firmware can discard the Euclidean project extension on save.

load.display: Adds under 0.1% of an audio block over stock, average and worst case (emulator)
load.conditions: Emulator: OS 1.53 on Core 2.1, 8 audio tracks triggering a full-scale sample and 8 MIDI tracks a note on every step at 120 BPM, 3,000 audio blocks timed with the MCF5441x instruction-timing model at 250 MHz, zero-wait memory. Module workload: Euclidean 16/16 on all sixteen tracks. Stock: 59.1% average, 61.8% worst block. All six mods together: 73.2% worst block on 1.53, 73.3% on 1.54. Not a hardware measurement.

hardware.summary: sumedho tested 1.1.6 on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, with all six mods and with Euclidean alone: holding FUNC while turning D off no longer clicks, playing or stopped, on audio and MIDI tracks, and still converts the rhythm to ordinary trigs; plain D off stays silent, page keys leave Euclidean and FUNC + AMP reopens it, and settings survived project save/reload and a power cycle (2026-11-04). Reported working, with no failures.
limitations: Outcomes were reported for the checklist in evidence/func-euc-off-1.1.6.json as a whole, not itemized per image.

Tested SysEx (all six mods): 1.53 ad46ffa76fe261ae8fb541767c693e9d3f3f3c48fe7a9aa340af8756eb9eeb47, 1.54 eb119355d3514132ceae730d3cc9a45d64f82a01f2cc61c0d6c3ed3adccc0869; Euclidean alone: 1.53 1ea0d1a65538ed456821130e130f9d7c27d2dd4e1586a0ccea8ad1a1754542bf, 1.54 ebc31354507f2f154159398e44e2efca14b80791735e2688ceb5e879e5c53b70. Firmware was not read back from the device.

tests.summary: Runs on Core 2.1. Emulator regressions on OS 1.53 and 1.54, an emulator CPU-load comparison with stock, Modwerk source-build parity with the native build, and the 1.1.6 conversion-click analysis are in TESTING.md. sumedho tested 1.1.6 on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, with all six mods and alone, including project save/reload and a power cycle (2026-11-04).
